name: ESP-01S
title: ESP8266 Wi-Fi module (AT firmware, UART) on an ESP-01 adapter v1.0 with 3.3 V regulator and level shifter
titleRu: Wi-Fi модуль ESP8266 ESP-01S (AT-прошивка, UART) на адаптере ESP-01 v1.0 со стабилизатором 3,3 В и преобразователем уровней

pins.name: RX
pins.desc: Serial data into the module, connect to the MCU TX (swap RX/TX if no reply)

pins.name: TX
pins.desc: Serial data from the module, connect to the MCU RX

pins.name: VCC
pins.desc: 5 V typical input of the adapter regulator, not for the bare module

notes: The bare ESP-01/ESP-01S is 3.3 V only (not 5 V tolerant) and can draw about 170 mA, more than an Uno 3.3 V pin supplies.
The v1.0 adapter has an onboard 3.3 V regulator (input 5 V typical, up to 12 V), MOSFET level shifting on TX/RX, and ties CH_PD high; RST is left floating.
Stock AT firmware usually runs at 115200 baud; SoftwareSerial on an Uno is unreliable at that speed, so lower the module baud rate or use a hardware UART.
Silkscreen labels differ between sellers: if there is no answer, swap the TX and RX wires. Pin order in the card follows the ProtoSupplies listing.
